arguments.text: Good start. Settle now to steady race effort, long way to go.

6000 m, 6 legs of 1000 m out-and-back. Goal: near-even effort at about sustainable shaft power (~195-200 W pod, boat CP 131 W) so the pod reserve reaches near zero only at the finish. Start was hot (255 W pod at 1 min, reserve 73%). Ease to settle, then hold. Compare out vs back legs for current. Final sprint (finish) from about 400-500 m to go if reserve allows. Watch for incidents: rudder weed (speed drops at same power), wind shift, pod drift, radio course changes.

arguments.message: GPS speed well below what pod power should give (beyond current): weed on rudder, wind, or pod drift?
Pod reserve below 20% with more than 1200 m left
Shaft power well above sustainable for 45 s
Shaft power well below sustainable for 60 s: fading, backing off, or pod reading low

arguments.reason: Decide on final sprint timing from reserve
